justification: B's PlaceOrder is a flat four-step pipeline where each failure branch shows its cause inline (plain ifs, 'payment-declined'/'save-failed' literals at the branch site, validation error order literally sequential in the body), and it reuses the domain's own Try/out idiom for missing skus. A routes every failure through Validation/Option/Result containers (TryGetValue+TryGetErrors discards, an exotic FromTry out-param lambda, Match indirection), so causes and accumulation order must be trusted to library semantics and comments, with promo knowledge split across three methods.
